runtimeArgs:
import os,functools,http.server,socketserver
p=int(os.environ.get('PORT','8000'))
h=functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=os.getcwd())
socketserver.TCPServer.allow_reuse_address=True
print('serving on',p,flush=True)
socketserver.TCPServer(('',p),h).serve_forever()
